text.p: Frontier Petroleum NL said it plans to raise A$5.47 million through a 1-for-1 rights issue, with one free attaching option, at an issue price of eight cents per share. The renounceable issue is not underwritten.

The company said funds raised would be used to fund the company's share of the ongoing exploration and appraisal programme in the Hanoi Basin production sharing contract in northern Vietnam and to provide further working capital.
The Hanoi Basin contract is held by Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd which is in turn owned 20 percent by Frontier and 80 percent by Anzoil NL.

"To the extent that shareholders do not support the issue by subscribing for their entitlement the company may be required to dilute its equity in Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd in accordance with the terms of the Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd shareholders agreement," Frontier said. The company has 68.36 million shares on issue.
The options are exercisable on or before June 30, 1998 at 20 cents each. Books closing and acceptance dates will be determined when the prospectus is lodged, Frontier said.
Frontier shares closed at 11.5 cents on Friday.
